sizeLimit: Import a BOM table up to 1 MiB.
tableLimit: Import up to 200 rows and 64 columns per BOM.
flagDnp: Line {row}: DNP value "{value}" is ambiguous. Use blank/no/false/0 or yes/true/1.
flagExclude: Line {row}: Exclude value "{value}" is ambiguous. Use blank/no/false/0 or yes/true/1.
referenceRange: Line {row}: unsupported reference range. Use explicit references.
referenceRangeValue: Line {row}: unsupported reference range {value}. Use explicit references.
referenceLimit: Line {row}: too many references. Split the group into smaller BOM rows.
mapping: Map value and quantity to separate columns. Each column can be used once.
quantity: Line {row}: quantity must be a positive decimal, without formulas, grouping or unit suffixes.
duplicate: Line {row}: reference {reference} appears more than once.
empty: No component rows remain after exclusions.
sourceSize: Import a BOM table up to 1 MiB
sourceChanged: BOM source no longer matches the original
sourceEncoding: Import a BOM table encoded as UTF-8.
